faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Research Assistant position at NIT Rourkela?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the Research Assistant position at NIT Rourkela is 25th September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Research Assistant role?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Master's degree (PG) in a relevant discipline such as Management, Commerce, Economics, Sociology, or Social Work to be eligible for the Research Assistant position.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Research Assistant recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Research Assistant position is 35 years. Age relaxation is provided for reserved categories as per government norms.

faq.question: Q4. How will candidates be selected for the Research Assistant post?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Research Assistant post involves shortlisting candidates based on their merit, followed by a walk-in interview.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Research Assistant position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Research Assistant position will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 30,000 per month.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) in the official notification for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. What is the total number of vacancies for the Research Assistant post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Research Assistant post at the National Institute of Technology Rourkela.

faq.question: Q8. What is the mode of application for this job?
faq.answer: The application for the Research Assistant position at NIT Rourkela must be submitted via email.

faq.question: Q9. Where is NIT Rourkela located?
faq.answer: National Institute of Technology Rourkela is located in Rourkela, Odisha, with the pincode 769008.

faq.question: Q10. When is the walk-in interview scheduled?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the Research Assistant position at NIT Rourkela is scheduled to be held on 1st October 2026.
